request.state:
L01: The archive tool keeps a copy of every finished order form.
L02: It writes into the cold store and never into the working store.
L03: An operator may pause it from the console at any time.
L04: A paused job resumes where it stopped.
L05: The job starts at 02:00 in the server's own time zone.
L06: A run that takes longer than four hours raises a warning.
L07: The warning goes to the duty mailbox.
L08: Old copies are kept for seven years.
L09: A copy is never deleted by the tool itself.
L10: Deletion is a separate request from the records desk.
L11: The console shows the last ten runs.
L12: Anything older lives in the run log.

q1.instructions: Which line states the hour at which the nightly archive job starts?
